description: Honest hardware monitoring for Windows. No account, no telemetry.
notes: Aikonic installs a Windows service and a Microsoft-attested kernel driver, so msiexec needs admin rights.
Windows will show one UAC prompt during install; accept it.

script: if ($newest -and ($newest -ge [version]$version)) { throw "Aikonic $newest is already installed, so Scoop has not installed $version over it and nothing was changed. Aikonic updates itself from the app." }
if ($proc.ExitCode -eq 3010) { warn 'Install needs a restart to complete.' } elseif ($proc.ExitCode -notin 0, 1641) { throw "msiexec /i failed with exit code $($proc.ExitCode); see $log" }

if ($proc.ExitCode -eq 1605) { warn "Aikonic $version is no longer installed, so Scoop removed nothing. A newer Aikonic may still be installed; remove it from Windows Settings if you want it gone." } elseif ($proc.ExitCode -eq 3010) { warn 'Removal needs a restart to complete.' } elseif ($proc.ExitCode -notin 0, 1641) { throw "msiexec /x failed with exit code $($proc.ExitCode)" }
